AMO.P.2.1-16.text: Judgment on Moab, Judah, and Israel

AMO.P.6.1-7.text: Woe to Those at Ease in Zion

AMO.P.7.1-9.text: The Locusts, Fire, and Plumb Line

AMO.1.1-2.text: Amos speaks as the LORD roars from Zion

AMO.1.3-4.text: The LORD will punish Damascus for its cruelty

AMO.1.5-5.text: The LORD will break Damascus and send Aram into exile

AMO.1.6-7.text: The LORD will punish Gaza for selling exiles to Edom

AMO.1.8-8.text: The LORD will judge the Philistine cities

AMO.1.9-10.text: The LORD will punish Tyre for breaking its covenant

AMO.1.11-12.text: The LORD will punish Edom for hating his brother

AMO.1.13-13.text: The LORD will punish the Ammonites for killing pregnant women

AMO.1.14-15.text: The LORD will burn Rabbah and send its king into exile

AMO.2.1-1.text: The LORD will punish Moab for burning a king’s bones

AMO.2.2-3.text: The LORD will send fire on Moab and its ruler

AMO.2.4-5.text: The LORD will punish Judah for rejecting his Law

AMO.2.6-6.text: The LORD will punish Israel for selling the needy

AMO.2.7-8.text: The LORD accuses Israel of cruelty to poor people

AMO.2.9-10.text: The LORD reminds Israel how he destroyed the Amorites

AMO.2.11-12.text: The LORD says Israel silenced the prophets

AMO.2.13-14.text: The LORD will crush Israel and no one will escape

AMO.2.15-16.text: Even Israel’s strongest soldiers will run away

AMO.3.1-2.text: The LORD will punish Israel, the people he knows

AMO.3.3-4.text: Amos asks questions about cause and result

AMO.3.5-6.text: Amos asks if disaster comes without the LORD

AMO.3.7-8.text: The LORD tells his plans to the prophets

AMO.3.9-10.text: The LORD calls Ashdod and Egypt to see Samaria’s violence

AMO.3.11-12.text: An enemy will take Samaria and little will be saved

AMO.3.13-14.text: The LORD will destroy the altars of Bethel

AMO.3.15-15.text: The LORD will destroy the houses of the rich

AMO.4.1-2.text: God warns the rich women of Samaria who oppress the poor

AMO.4.3-3.text: God says the women will be taken out through broken walls

AMO.4.4-5.text: God mocks Israel’s false worship at Bethel and Gilgal

AMO.4.6-7.text: God sent hunger and no rain, yet Israel did not return

AMO.4.8-9.text: God ruined the crops, but Israel did not return

AMO.4.10-11.text: God sent plagues and war, yet Israel did not return

AMO.4.12-13.text: Israel must prepare to meet God, the maker of all

AMO.5.1-2.text: Amos sings a sad song because Israel has fallen

AMO.5.3-3.text: Most of the soldiers from Israel’s cities will die

AMO.5.4-5.text: God urges Israel to seek him, not Bethel or Gilgal

AMO.5.6-7.text: Israel must seek the LORD and live, or face fire

AMO.5.8-9.text: The LORD made the stars and brings down the strong

AMO.5.10-11.text: Israel’s rich hate honest people and trample the poor

AMO.5.12-13.text: God knows Israel takes bribes and denies the poor justice

AMO.5.14-15.text: God urges Israel to seek good and establish justice

AMO.5.16-17.text: God will pass through Israel and everyone will mourn

AMO.5.18-20.text: The Day of the LORD will be darkness for Israel, not light

AMO.5.21-22.text: God hates Israel’s feasts and will not accept offerings

AMO.5.23-24.text: God rejects Israel’s songs and wants justice like a river

AMO.5.25-26.text: God accuses Israel of carrying idols in the wilderness

AMO.5.27-27.text: God will send Israel into exile beyond Damascus

AMO.6.1-2.text: God warns the proud leaders who feel safe in Samaria

AMO.6.3-4.text: The rich ignore coming trouble and live in luxury

AMO.6.5-6.text: The rich enjoy wine and music but ignore Israel’s ruin

AMO.6.7-7.text: The proud leaders will be the first taken into exile

AMO.6.8-8.text: God hates Israel’s pride and will give up the city

AMO.6.9-10.text: Even ten men in one house will die

AMO.6.11-11.text: The LORD commands that every house will be destroyed

AMO.6.12-13.text: The LORD says Israel has turned justice into poison

AMO.6.14-14.text: The LORD will bring a nation to oppress Israel

AMO.7.1-3.text: Amos sees locusts, and the LORD hears his prayer

AMO.7.4-6.text: Amos sees a fire, and the LORD stops it

AMO.7.7-8.text: The LORD shows Amos a plumb line for Israel

AMO.7.9-9.text: The LORD will destroy Israel’s holy places and Jeroboam’s house

AMO.7.10-11.text: Amaziah tells King Jeroboam that Amos plots against him

AMO.7.12-13.text: Amaziah tells Amos to leave Bethel

AMO.7.14-15.text: Amos says the LORD called him from his flock

AMO.7.16-17.text: Amos tells Amaziah what the LORD will do to him

AMO.8.1-3.text: A basket of summer fruit shows the end of Israel

AMO.8.4-6.text: The LORD condemns those who cheat and trample the poor

AMO.8.7-8.text: The LORD will not forget what the Israelites have done

AMO.8.9-10.text: The LORD will turn Israel’s feasts into mourning

AMO.8.11-12.text: The LORD will send a famine of hearing his words

AMO.8.13-14.text: Young people will faint and false worshipers will fall

AMO.9.1-2.text: The LORD says no one in Israel can escape him

AMO.9.3-4.text: The LORD will find those who hide from him

AMO.9.5-6.text: The LORD is the powerful God who rules earth and sea

AMO.9.7-8.text: The LORD will destroy the sinful kingdom but not all Jacob

AMO.9.9-10.text: The LORD will sift Israel and kill the sinners

AMO.9.11-12.text: The LORD promises to rebuild David’s fallen tent

AMO.9.13-13.text: The LORD promises a time of great harvests

AMO.9.14-15.text: The LORD promises to bring Israel home and plant them there
